body.p: The Ex Parte Quayle Action dated December 19, 2024, has been carefully reviewed, and the forgoing amendment and the following remarks have been made in consequence thereof.

Applicant thanks Examiner Sienko for the interview conducted on January 28, 2025. During the interview, Specification objection 13 stated on page 4 of the Ex Parte Quayle Action was discussed. An agreement was reached that "available distance" is a general term of distance that is available under different conditions or scenarios. Examiner Sienko indicated that the language at paragraph [0068] may remain as it is and no further action is necessary.

Three Replacement Sheets are submitted herewith for original FIGS. 2, 6, and 7A. The Replacement sheets comply with 37 CFR 1.84(p)(5) and include reference sign(s) mentioned in the description. Applicant respectfully submits that no new matter is added by any of these amendments.

The Office asserts that the drawings are objected to "because in Fig. 2, 'Object Node' is referred to by 114 (which is found in Fig. 1 labeling 'Object Node'), while in Fig. 2, 'Map Node' is referred to by 204 (different from the label found in Fig. 1, where 'Mapping Node' is labeled with 116)." Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 2. Applicant has amended FIG. 2 to depict "Mapping Node" for label 204 and replaced the 114 label for "Object Node" with a 202 label.
The Office has also objected to the drawings for failing to comply with 37 CFR 1.84(p)(5) because they do not include the following reference sign(s) mentioned in the description.
"Fig 2.: the description in [0041] mentions 'an object node 202' and 202 is missing from Fig. 2." Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 2. As previously discussed, Applicant has amended FIG.
2 to replace the 114 label with a 202 label.

"Fig. 6: 612 and 614 are missing and [0057] mentions 'a trajectory distance 612' and 'a specific duration or ('time' 614)"'. Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 2. Applicant has amended FIG. 6 to include labels 612 and 614 for "a trajectory distance" and "a specific duration or time" respectively.
"Fig. 7A: does not show what its description in [0061] states." Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 2. Applicant has amended FIG. 7A to show what its description in [0061] states.
The Office has objected to the disclosure because of the following informalities:

"[0041]: as mentioned above, 202 as a label is missing from Fig. 2, where the object node is labelled 114." Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 3. As previously discussed, Applicant has amended FIG. 2 to replace the 114 label with a 202 label.

"[0049]: '...consuming one or more distance and/or velocity bounds.' Is this really the word wanted here." Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 3. Applicant has amended [0049] to recite "generating" instead of "consuming".

"[0061]: The situation shown in Fig. 7A does not show what is described here." Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 3. As previously discussed, Applicant has amended FIG. 7A to show what its description in [0061] states.

"[0066]: 'position bound(trajectory end time) can be the position or distance of the maximum distance bound at the end of the candidate trajectory...' should probably be restated as 'position bound(trajectory end time) can be the position or distance of the maximum distance bound at the end time of the candidate trajectory... "' Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 3. Applicant has amended [0066] according to the Office's suggestion.

"[0066]: 'trajectory end position(trajectory end time) can be the position or distance of the vehicle relative to the initial position of the vehicle at the end of the candidate trajectory...' is confusing because 'initial position of the vehicle at the end of the candidate trajectory' makes no

sense." Ex Parte Quayle at pages 3-4. The Office then asserts "if this phrase has been interpreted correctly, it would be better stated as: 'trajectory end position(trajectory end time) can be the position or distance of the vehicle at the end of the candidate trajectory, relative to the initial position of the vehicle..."' Ex Parte Quayle Action at pages 3 and 4. Applicant has further amended [0066] according to the Office's suggestion.

"[0066]: 'the comfort deceleration parameter can be a or a defined value'; it looks like there is a word missing." Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 4. Applicant has further amended [0066] to recite "the comfort deceleration parameter can be a defined value".

"[0068]: 'Using the slope of the maximum distance bound and transforming the slope into an available distance...' would seem to have a different interpretation of 'available distance' than what is found in earlier paragraphs." Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 4. As previously discussed, "available distance" is a general term of distance that is available under different conditions or scenarios. As agreed during the examiner interview, the language in this paragraph may remain as it is and no further action is necessary
"[0072]: the second instance of 'At step 812...' should be 'At step 814..."' Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 4. Applicant has amended [0072] according to the Office's suggestion.

"[0073]: The two mentions of 'candidate trajectory' in the line 2 should probably be 'candidate trajectories."' Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 4. Applicant has amended [0073] according to the Office's suggestion.
"[0073]: '...at step 814,...' should be '...at step 816,..."' Ex Parte Quayle Action at page
4. Applicant has amended [0073] according to the Office's suggestion.

"[0073]: 'At step 816, the data processing system...' should be 'At step 818, the data processing system... "' Ex Parte Quayle Action at page 4. Applicant has further amended [0073] according to the Office's suggestion.
Applicant thanks the Examiner for indicating that claims 1-20 are allowed. In view of the foregoing, Applicant respectfully submits this application is in condition for allowance.
Applicant authorizes the Commissioner to charge any additional fees which may be due in connection with this Amendment to Deposit Account No. 01-2384 in the name of Armstrong Teasdale LLP.
Respectfully submitted,
